Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 2655/2022

Dear Mr. Pillai,

Thank you for meeting us on 28/09/2022 about your dispute with Vivek Bose. As we understand it, relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land.

Our advice is to trace the chain of title through the mutation entries. Please collect the mutation entries, the partition deed and the old sale deeds and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹4.6 crore.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
